{{Infobox animal | name = Otter | image = [[File:Otter.jpg|thumb|An otter {{convert|1|m}} long]] }} <!-- lead sentence below --> An '''otter''' is an [[animal]] that lives in and near [[water|fresh and salt water]].<ref name="fur">Otter fur handbook.</ref> Otters have long thin bodies & thick brown fur.<ref/> They eat [[fish]], frogs and shellfish. [[Category:Mammals]]
== Description == This section is cut away with its own sentences.
A talk page is never an article, whatever its text says here.
A '''harbor''' is a place on the coast where [[ship]]s can shelter from bad weather. Ships load and unload goods in a harbor.
'''Crane''' may mean more than one thing. It is a long enough page to pass every length check. {{disambiguation}}
A Zorbulon is an invented thing with a title no lexicon resolves, so it never ships however clean its prose is.
{| class="wikitable" |- ! Region !! Meadows |- | North || 12 |} A '''meadow''' is a field of grass and wild flowers. Meadows are open land with few or no trees.
